stem.en: The two first guesses, tested. Is each statement true or false?

text.en: With no tools, a model finds its answer in a stored list of sentences.
An app can search the web and paste the results in as text for the model.
A picture model makes each picture by joining pieces of stored pictures.
A picture that appears a huge number of times in the pile can come out as a near copy.
The finished dragon was hidden inside the starting noise all along.

explanation.en: A model calculates its answer from settings, and looking things up is a job for the app. A picture model keeps settings, not pictures, and the picture is made during the steps, although a very common image can be learned so well that it is nearly copied.

hints.en: Ask which part does the job: the model or the app, the settings or a store.
